messages:
harper: heads-up: promote for release/2.7.1 is blocked. postsubmit shows artefact verification failing due to cache-key mismatch on wheels bundle.

ci-bot: Postsubmit publish job failed: build/artifact-verify (exit 1) https://ci.internal/runs/102500 :x:

harper: error in verify step: expected sha256=abc123 but got sha256=def456 for package redwood-core-2.7.1-py3-none.whl. appears only on some runners.

leo: That smells like parallel cache upload / index race. We recently changed the cache indexer to emit compact keys (PR#4722).

tess: deploy-bot paused promotion: :warning:

deploy-bot: Promotion paused for release/2.7.1 by CI gate (artifact verification failed). I will auto-unpause when main & canary pass the artifact-verify stage.

infra-bot: Noted. Scanning artifact service logs for conflicting uploads. Found concurrent PUTs with identical object name but different content, upload-ids 0x4a/0x5b.

leo: options: 1) pin to last-known-good build artifact (re-run CI using previous wheel), 2) add stricter object-atomicity/lock in uploader and re-run, 3) revert compact-key change, 4) re-upload artifacts with a unique suffix and update index (ugly).

harper: We need to decide quickly: change window cutoff in 35m. Fastest is pin to previous wheel and re-run verify. Longer term we fix uploader idempotency.

tess: Agree. Pinning means a temporary mismatch between built source and published wheel if there were code changes. Do we accept that risk?

harper: The change is documentation-only in this patchset (no code path changes). Risk low. I'll open a pin commit: git checkout -b pin/wheel-2.7.0 && sed -i 's/version: 2.7.1/version: 2.7.0/' release-manifest.yml && git commit -am "pin wheel to 2.7.0 to bypass cachekey mismatch" && git push origin pin/wheel-2.7.0

ci-bot: Manual rerun link: https://ci.internal/manual/102500?action=rerun

leo: If pinning unblocks, we should still create a blocking ticket to revert pin once uploader fix lands and reverify build integrity (INFRA-1215).

infra-bot: Quick fix attempt: updating uploader to check upload-id vs existing object-etag and retry with new id if conflict detected. Pushing hotfix branch fix/uploader-retry now.

ci-bot: Rerun result: pinned run passed artifact-verify at 1751004520.

tess: Good. deploy-bot resuming promotion. Note: must record in release notes that wheel was pinned and that checksum mismatch was observed.

harper: I'll add this to the release notes: "Temporarily pinned Python wheel to 2.7.0 due to intermittent artifact-index race causing checksum mismatch on some runners. Follow-up: INFRA-1215 to fix uploader idempotency and re-validate 2.7.1 artifacts."

leo: Also filing a postmortem and a test to simulate concurrent PUTs in the uploader integration tests.

infra-bot: Monitoring artifact publish logs for 1 hour; will alert on any 409/etag mismatch anomalies.

ci-bot: Canary deployed to us-central-1 at 1751004630.

harper: update 1751004699: promotion resumed, canary promoted. closing provisional hold but keeping INFRA-1215 on our sprint board.

leo: action items: leo -> uploader fix + test (INFRA-1215), harper -> release notes + pin revert plan, tess -> update release calendar.

harper: closing thread for this window.
